items.title: Annual fees for transport licence holders and service providers invoiced in February 2027
items.summary: Transport licence holders and those notified as service providers are charged an annual fee. If an operator no longer provides transport services, it is advisable to cancel the transport licence or notification. The annual fee is charged to all licence holders and service providers that are entered in the Transport Register on 1 January 2027.

items.title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: Agentic Threat Activity Crosses a Significant Threshold
items.summary: As threat actors increasingly move beyond basic prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent frameworks, automated vulnerability exploitation pipelines, and alternative monetization schemes like LLMJacking, the adversarial AI landscape has reached a critical inflection point. In this update, Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant examine how adversaries across the cyber crime, espionage, and information operations spectrum are operationalizing generative AI to compress attack timelines, scale operations, and execute multi-stage intrusions at machine speed.

items.title: Microsoft says months-old bug caused global Microsoft 365 outage
items.summary: In a preliminary post-incident report shared in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, the company said the outage was caused by three problems: a previously undetected software bug, increased traffic after a Microsoft Teams failover, and reduced server capacity.

items.title: Multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities in danfoss sm-800A
items.summary: As we will demonstrate in this blogpost, Midnight Blue researcher Carlo Meijer found several pre-authentication remote code execution 0-day vulnerabilities in the Danfoss AK-SM 800A in less than an hour with casual manual inspection. ... We are currently in a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process with Danfoss and as such will withhold technical details until disclosure is sorted, but due to ongoing targeting of these controllers we consider it important asset owners have a realistic view of the overall security posture of these devices ontrollers in order to take the appropriate measures rather than rely on piecemeal patching.

items.title: Viranomainen varoittaa: Tämä kodin laite kannattaa suojata nyt
items.summary: Vaikka yksittäisen kotitalouden ei tarvitsekaan huolestua kylmälaiteiskujen takia, oman kotiverkon suojaaminen on silti tärkeää, Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskus toteaa. Usein olohuoneessa nököttävä ja internetin kotiin jakava laatikko eli reititin on turvallisuuden kannalta kriittinen. – Kodin älylaitteiden tietoturvasta huolehtiminen ei vaadi erityistä teknistä osaamista. Jo oletussalasanojen vaihtaminen, ohjelmistojen päivittäminen ja tarpeettomien etäyhteyksien poistaminen käytöstä parantavat laitteiden turvallisuutta, Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksen tietoturva-asiantuntija Antti Nikkinen sanoo tiedotteessa.

items.title: NoisyTCP bug gives Linux servers a remote crash problem 11 years in the making
items.summary: The researcher who sounded the alarm over Dirty Frag earlier this year has uncovered another Linux kernel flaw, and this one lets attackers crash entire servers remotely without so much as a password. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-99288 and dubbed NoisyTCP, was discovered by security researcher Hyunwoo Kim, who says it affects almost all Linux distributions. The flaw dates back to October 2015 and went unnoticed until this year, when Kim found and patched it.
